note: The frontal ridge of the soldier is band-like, with two tubercles on each side, an upper one thick and long and a lower one short; this is the typical structure of a phragmotic head (used to plug the gallery opening). Type locality Colombo, Sri Lanka.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The lectotype soldier is deposited in the Zoological Institute of Lund University, Sweden; type locality Colombo, Sri Lanka. The literature records the species from India, Sri Lanka and elsewhere.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax and abdominal tergites pale brownish yellow; antennae, labrum and legs pale yellow; sternites paler than the tergites. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length with wings 7.0—7.69 mm, without wings 4.52—4.95 mm. Head capsule almost square, its length including the eyes almost equal to the length to the mandibular base (length 0.80 mm, width 0.77—0.81 mm); sides nearly parallel; frons weakly concave in the middle. Eyes oval, slightly narrowed behind; greatest diameter 0.27 mm. Ocelli oval, translucent, touching the eyes; length 0.10 mm, width 0.05 mm. Antennae 13—14-segmented; with 13 segments segment 3 is large, longer and thicker than segment 4; with 14 segments segment 3 is as long as segment 4 but narrower. Clypeus almost trapezoidal, the boundary between ante- and postclypeus indistinct. Labrum broadly ligulate, wider than long (length 0.23 mm, width 0.30 mm), with hairs on the anterior margin and on the body. Mandibles not examined. Pronotum flat, almost reniform, length 0.50 mm, width 0.70 mm, narrower than the head including the eyes; anterior margin rather incurved, without a median notch; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Wings hyaline, faintly brownish, with punctures (warts). Forewing 6.15 mm long: radius merging with the costa before about 1/5 of the wing membrane; radial sector with 6 branches reaching the costa, the first branching at about 1/5 of the membrane; media joining the radial sector at about 3/5 of the membrane; cubitus with 12 branches reaching the posterior margin. Hindwing 5.45 mm long: radius meeting the costa before about 1/4 of the membrane; radial sector with 4 branches reaching the costa, the first branching at about 2/5 of the membrane; media meeting the radial sector about one third of the way to the wing tip; cubitus with 11 branches reaching the posterior margin. Abdomen long, hairy; cerci 2-segmented; styli single-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule black, blackish brown behind; antennae, labrum, legs and body pale brown; anterior margin of the pronotum dark brown; mandibles black, red-black distally. Head sparsely hairy, the body more hairy. Body length 2.9—4.3 mm. Head capsule thick and short (length to the mandibular base 0.97—1.03 mm, width 0.90—1.00 mm); frons deeply incurved and truncate, forming an angle greater than 90° with the mandibles; frontal ridge prominent, band-like; two tubercles on each side, the upper thick and long, the lower short; vertex with a median concavity behind the frontal ridge. Eyes small, oval (long diameter 0.07 mm). Antennae 10—11-segmented; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 as long as segment 2 or shorter (with 11 segments), sometimes further divided (with 10 segments). Anteclypeus thin and translucent, linear; postclypeus almost rectangular, its boundary with the frons indistinct. Labrum almost triangular, wider at the base than long, with several setae near the tip. Mandibles short and thick, the outer margin distinctly raised above the condyle; each with 2 small marginal teeth.
